purpose: 25k-step PPO-vs-SAC verification pilot pair for the algorithm switch (train_ppo.py algorithm: ppo|sac)

reading: Both learn healthily from pixels; SAC overtakes PPO ~15k and ends +23% ep_rew_mean at the 25k budget with slightly lower cage intervention. 25k is far from the 1-D convergence regime (PPO peaks ~823 at ~297k) - a pilot sanity check, not an algorithm verdict.
